title: Quota shadowing and amortized trial->reserved conversion for seamless billing cutover
creator: Arielle Kim
description:
Problem: customers converting active trial or hosted consumption accounts to Reserved capacity today experience billing discontinuities and quota surprises because we switch from per-token metering to monthly reserved allowances at an instant cutover. This causes a) immediate throttles or unexpected overage charges if historical usage wasn't amortized, and b) operational toil for support and manual invoice adjustments.

Goal: implement a "quota shadowing" mode and an amortized conversion algorithm so that when an account is converted to Reserved, the system simultaneously: 1) keeps a shadowed copy of their effective pre-conversion usage trajectory, 2) computes an amortized offset across the remaining reserved billing window, and 3) applies a gradual quota transition that is reversible if the conversion is rolled back within a short window. The feature should be transparent to customers via the Console and produce clear audit telemetry for billing reconciliation and SRE diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: API: new conversion endpoint returns deterministic amortized quota adjustments and a conversion-id for audit
Accuracy: amortization math matches Confluence spec and unit tests across day-aligned and rolling-window billing calendars
Safety: a dry-run shadow-only mode that performs dual-write telemetry without changing enforcement must be available for 2 weeks before any live enrollments
Rollback: conversions can be reverted within the configured grace period without leaving incorrect billing ledgers
Observability: Console shows pre/post quota curves, token-level deltas, and a conversion audit log entry
Telemetry: billing events include conversion-id and amortized-credit amount for downstream invoicing pipeline
proposal_steps: Design Confluence doc: define amortization formula for both calendar-month and tenant-anchored rolling windows (link under docs_links)
Schema: add conversion_id to quota-ledger entries and add shadow_ledger namespace for transient entries
API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/convert_reserved with params {start_date, reserved_months, dry_run=false} returning conversion_id and amortized_credit
Enforcement: dual-path enforcement where shadow entries are recorded but not used until dry_run=false; on switch, atomically flip enforcement pointer for tenant to reserved ledger
Reconciliation: background job to reconcile shadow_ledger vs final ledger and emit correction invoices if drift > threshold
Console: show proposed amortized schedule during conversion flow and a post-conversion timeline
Rollout: enable feature flag, run in dry_run shadow mode for 2 weeks with telemetry and manual audit, then enable live mode for small pilot customers, then gradual ramp
tasks: Backend: ledger schema migration and conversion_id support (owner: Eng)
Worker: amortization calculator + reconciliation job (owner: Eng)
Console: UX for conversion preview and audit trail (owner: DX)
E2E: unit + integration tests with DST/tenant timezone scenarios (owner: Eng QA)
Telemetry: add conversion-tagged billing events and dashboards (owner: SRE)
Docs: public-facing guide and billing FAQ (owner: PM)
Pilot: identify 3 customers for live pilot and run manual invoices to verify correctness (owner: CS)
